description.tr: Antik Yunanistan'in tanrilari, kahramanlari ve efsaneleri. Olympos Dagi'ndan Yeralti Dunyasi'na uzanan destansi hikayeler.
description.en: Gods, heroes, and legends of Ancient Greece. Epic tales spanning from Mount Olympus to the Underworld.

description.tr: Vikinglerin tanrilari ve destanlari. Yggdrasil'den Ragnarok'e, buz ve atesin hikayesi.
description.en: Gods and sagas of the Vikings. From Yggdrasil to Ragnarok, a tale of ice and fire.

description.tr: Nil'in kiyisinda dogan kadim tanrilar ve olumsuzluk arayisi. Ra'dan Osiris'e, piramitlerin ardindaki sirlar.
description.en: Ancient gods born on the banks of the Nile and the quest for immortality. From Ra to Osiris, the secrets behind the pyramids.

description.tr: Medeniyetin besigi Mezopotamya'nin tanrilari. Sumer'den Babil'e, insanligin ilk yazili destanlari.
description.en: Gods of Mesopotamia, the cradle of civilization. From Sumer to Babylon, humanity's first written epics.

description.tr: Gunesin dogdugu yerin tanrilari ve ruhlari. Amaterasu'dan yokai'lere, Sinto ve Budist geleneklerin birlestigi masallar.
description.en: Gods and spirits of the Land of the Rising Sun. From Amaterasu to yokai, tales where Shinto and Buddhist traditions converge.

description.tr: Sis kapli ormanlarin ve kutsal kaynaklarin tanrilari. Druidler, periler ve savascilarin destansi hikayeleri.
description.en: Gods of mist-covered forests and sacred springs. Epic tales of druids, faeries, and warriors.
